3a8b95623bfbca0404372fe5d4a9fa89dbfa3aa8.summary: Dark Matter LLC's 2018 conference talk on WINDSHIFT APT, a long-term, non-attributable cyber-espionage actor that targets specific individuals and government. It describes multi-phase operations: fake social media personas, benign-email reconnaissance, one-day credential harvesting and occasional malware delivery. It covers macOS tools WINDTAIL.A/B/C and WINDTAPE, and the Windows dropper WINDDROP (2017-2018). Attribution links reused Appin Security tools (Operation Hangover, 2012) and overlaps with BAHAMUT APT, Fancy Bear and SOFACY. The report itself hedges these links.
